subject.title: [Feature]: Non-interactive command to use Codex OAuth for model provider

question: Should OpenClaw add a non-interactive OpenAI ChatGPT/Codex OAuth setup/import path, and should that path accept a redirect callback URL, exchanged token material, or only an upstream-supported external-auth contract?
rationale: The missing capability is source-reproducible, but the proposed env callback shape changes the OAuth/security boundary and cannot be chosen safely by deterministic repair automation.

options.title: Design provider-owned handoff
options.body: Add the capability only after maintainers choose a narrow OpenAI-plugin contract with PKCE/state validation, redaction, docs, and setup/runtime tests.

options.title: Accept callback URL env import
options.body: Implement the requested env-style redirect URL import with strict validation and documented exposure tradeoffs.

options.title: Keep current supported flows
options.body: Continue supporting API-key automation, piped token import, browser OAuth, and device-code login until a safer upstream-supported auth handoff is available.

recommendation.title: Design provider-owned handoff
recommendation.body: Add the capability only after maintainers choose a narrow OpenAI-plugin contract with PKCE/state validation, redaction, docs, and setup/runtime tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The OpenAI provider identity, setup, and auth-profile history routes the product/security shape most strongly to this owner signal.
